intake.problem: Analyze the following business opportunity for Francisco Holdings Inc.: FHI has developed a governed multi-agent executive architecture with three specialized AI executives: PrimeDox for knowledge/research/education, Vigilax for security/risk/AI safety, and SoulStack for strategy/revenue/operations. The system is capable of analyzing public business websites and identifying opportunities, operational gaps, security concerns, automation opportunities, revenue opportunities, and optimization possibilities. The objective is to turn this capability into a legitimate high-value business diagnostic and optimization service that can be demonstrated first on FHI itself and then offered to companies, organizations, and other appropriate clients. Develop a concise proposal covering: the strongest commercial offer, ideal first customers, deliverables, differentiation, fastest path to revenue, risks, safeguards, and a practical first-client strategy. Do not recommend unauthorized access, exploitation, credential testing, destructive activity, or modifications to third-party systems.

executives.name: PrimeDox AI
executives.assignment: Analyze knowledge, education, documentation and evidence requirements.

executives.name: Vigilax AI
executives.assignment: Analyze security, privacy, AI-safety, fraud and operational risks.

executives.name: SoulStack AI
executives.assignment: Analyze customer value, revenue potential, operations, automation and speed to market.
